title: Within-family effect of ancestry on complex traits in a Mexican population.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: no PMCID, not open access in Europe PMC, no supplement, no accessions, no NCBI (National Center for Biotechnology Information) links, no Zenodo/Dryad records. A web search found the MCPS (Mexico City Prospective Study) data-access pages: researchers must apply, and approved users analyse the genetic data inside a DNAnexus trusted research environment (a locked cloud workspace). The CTSU (Oxford Clinical Trial Service Unit) policy page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: 15 complex traits measured in 52,583 unrelated people and 39,714 relatives from 17,627 families, with estimated genetic ancestry. Search snippets give the MCPS genetic data as 140,831 genotyped, 141,046 exome-sequenced and 9,950 whole-genome-sequenced participants.

a1_downloadable.note: Controlled access: MCPS individual-level genotypes and phenotypes need an application to the study's data access committee and can only be analysed inside a DNAnexus cloud workspace. Nothing can be downloaded to a laptop. Checked via the data-access pages found in search, not the files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked because A1 failed. The traits (height, type 2 diabetes and others) would be phenotype columns, but no file could be opened.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked because A1 failed. The inputs would be genotype arrays inside the controlled-access workspace.

a5_enough_rows.note: The abstract reports 52,583 unrelated people plus 39,714 relatives. That would be plenty, but I could not verify it in any file.

a6_fits_laptop.note: The policy requires analysis on a cloud platform (DNAnexus on AWS), which the laptop-only, no-cloud constraint rules out.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not checked. The traits are measured phenotypes according to the abstract, and ancestry estimates come from a model.

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: with no individual-level data accessible, no model could be trained.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a person's genotype and genetic ancestry to predict height, type 2 diabetes and metabolic traits in admixed Mexican adults.
plain_idea.train_on: Genotypes and ancestry estimates for each participant. About 92,000 people according to the abstract; unverified.
plain_idea.predict: Measured traits such as height and diabetes status, recorded at the study's baseline survey.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Genetic risk scores built mostly from European data transfer poorly to admixed Latin American people, so a model trained here would fill a real gap. But the data is locked behind an access application.

ml_idea: Polygenic or ancestry-aware trait prediction in admixed Mexican adults. Not feasible because individual-level MCPS data is controlled access and can only be analysed in the cloud.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: the data cannot be downloaded.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Data-access check: MCPS needs an application plus a DNAnexus cloud workspace, which kills the project.

verdict_reason: A1 fails. Mexico City Prospective Study genotypes and phenotypes are controlled access: you need an application to the data access committee, and analysis happens only in a DNAnexus cloud workspace. There is no open supplement or public deposit, and the paper is not open access in Europe PMC.
